articles.source_title: Grizzlies Acquire 2026 Draft Rights to Karim Lopez and Five Future Second Round Draft Picks
articles.source_excerpt: Memphis acquired Karim Lopez at No. 21 and five future second-round picks in the draft-rights transactions involving Oklahoma City and Detroit.

events.label: Memphis swaps 2026 draft rights with Oklahoma City and Detroit

pick_details_in.raw_text: 2026 draft rights to Karim Lopez, No. 21 overall
two future second-round picks from Oklahoma City
three future second-round picks from Detroit

pick_details_out.raw_text: 2026 draft rights to Bennett Stirtz, No. 16 overall
2026 draft rights to Ebuka Okorie, No. 17 overall

events.raw_note: Memphis first sent the No. 16 rights and two future seconds to Oklahoma City for No. 17 and then sent No. 17 and three future seconds to Detroit for No. 21. The five future seconds remain aggregate, non-projectable bundles until their exact identities are sourced.
